h1: Custom Embroidery Shorts for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom embroidery shorts in bulk for your team. Durable, professional, and perfect for uniforms. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Custom embroidery shorts offer a polished, long-lasting decoration method that stands up to frequent washing and active use. Unlike screen printing, embroidery adds dimensional texture that resists fading and cracking, making it ideal for uniforms, event staff, or company teams. Choose from cotton twill or performance blends and add your logo on the leg, hip, or back pocket for a professional finish that stays sharp season after season.
heroAltText: Custom embroidery shorts with logo on left leg, khaki color, worn by a person in an outdoor setting
